newsitem.title: JAPAN: NCB to leave March prime, debenture rates unchanged.
newsitem.headline: NCB to leave March prime, debenture rates unchanged.

text.p: Nippon Credit Bank Ltd said on Tuesday it would leave its long-term prime lending rate for March unchanged at 2.5 percent.
NCB also said it would leave the coupon rate on its March five-year debentures sold to institutional investors unchanged from the February issue at 2.35 percent.
The long-term prime lending rate, applied to loans of one year and longer to the bank's most creditworthy clients, was last cut in December to a record low 2.5 percent from 2.7 percent in November.

The spread of the coupon rate of NCB five-year debenture against that of benchmark Industrial Bank of Japan Ltd's will be 75 basis points in March. It was widened to 75 basis points in February from 55 points in December and January.
